program.major: Physics with Specialization in Computational Physics

notes: Computational Physics is an optional focus area within the BS, Physics (PY29) degree. Full requirement set = BS Physics core plus five restricted electives from the computational-physics focus list. Focus list verified verbatim.

buckets.label: Upper-Division Lab
buckets.note: One from PHYS 122, 124, 133, 173, or ASTR 150 (4 units).

buckets.label: Restricted Electives (Computational Physics focus)
buckets.note: Five restricted electives (20 units), 4+ units each; max two from outside physics (the MATH courses). Catalog verbatim: 'Computational physics: PHYS 105B, 141, 142; MATH 170A-B-C, 179, 183.'

buckets.label: Total Units for the Major
buckets.note: 52 lower-division + 57 upper-division units (same as base BS). This is a total unit count, not a course list. The BS Physics (PY29) / Computational Physics focus totals 109 units: 52 lower-division (8 PHYS core + 6 lower-div MATH) plus 57 upper-division (8 UD core + 1 UD lab + 5 restricted electives). No additional courses beyond the other buckets; the requirement is satisfied by accumulating >=109 units across the listed core/elective buckets.
